description: Fetch a single company by Prometiam internal ID, or by the register's own number: give country and company_number (NIF, SIREN or SIRET, CRN, KRS, CVR, ...; GET /companies/{country}/{company_number}, 1 credit, same answer and same include). No company with that number is a 404; a number several companies carry (US registers, a German commercial-register entry) is a 409 ambiguous_company_number whose error.candidates list the ids. Returns full profile including officers (appointments for ES, FR, GB, NO, PL, CZ and CO; Colombia: the legal representative the Chamber of Commerce registration names, name only, never an identification number, no dates, no person record or director network; Czech Republic: the members the register lists today, natural persons as the name and the month and year of birth only, a company member's foreign register number left out when it has the shape of a personal number, no officer history, no person records; null with a notice when they could not be read, which means unknown, not none), registry coordinates, founding date and the age fields (age_years, age_band, age_basis), the Latin name of a company whose register writes its name in another script (name_latin, name_latin_basis; the rules and limits are those of companies_search), the NACE class with its English title and the same industry as NACE Rev. 2 and Rev. 2.1, ISIC Rev. 4 and NAICS 2022 codes (the rules and limits are those of companies_search), capital, current standard status (with stage and the register's local_status), standard legal form (with local_legal_form and legal_form_elf, the ISO 20275 code, null where GLEIF's list has no single code for the form), identifiers, the NUTS 2024 regions (nuts1, nuts2, nuts3 with Eurostat’s names, nuts_version, lau_code; the same limits as companies_search: each level only where the register’s stated place is exactly one region, else null) and registry_details, and advertising_protected (Denmark: the CVR register mark that the company asked not to be contacted for direct marketing, CVR act s.19; true means do not use the record for direct marketing, false means the register states no protection, null for other countries and where the register holds no mark yet; the company is served either way). Also change_activity: events counted (not people; a kind once a day, a rewrite of an address or name with the same words not at all) of address, name, capital and management changes in the last 12 and 36 months, with history_from and window_complete (a window that begins before the feed does is a floor); null for GB and where the feed does not record a kind; see companies_search for the limits. Also licences: Registrations the company holds in a regulator's public register, from the registers read: for US companies the SEC's lists of registered investment advisers and exempt reporting advisers. The key is absent for a company of a country with no regulator register read. Each entry: regulator, register, licence_or_status, scope (the register's own words, in English where it publishes them so), since, until, countries (the countries of an EU passport entry, one entry per register and direction), register_id (the regulator's own number: SEC CRD number), as_at (the day the register's file was read) and source. A company is linked only through an exact identifier (the SEC CIK), never by name: a firm whose identifier we do not hold, or an adviser the SEC file lists without a CIK, is not matched. null means not found in the registers read, never "not licensed", and the entries are a snapshot as at `as_at`, not a live check of the register. Sole proprietorships and natural persons are not served. Company detail only, every plan, no extra credit; the answer's meta.attribution carries each register's credit. include=lei (Spain) adds lei_record, the GLEIF record; lei is the code string. recent_events (ES/FR/GB) carries the same served event_type + raw act_type as events_search. Get an ID from companies_search first. Pass include to attach extra blocks — notably risk_flags (published tax-debt / debarment signals; Colombia: procurement_fine; Spain also public grants as informational `subsidy` flags from the national grants database BDNS, concessions from 26 Sep 2026, legal entities only, never counted by has_risk_flag) and insolvency. UK disqualified directors: on a GB company, `disqualified_officers` lists the company's CURRENT officers who are on the Companies House register of disqualified directors with a disqualification in force (each with the same `disqualifications` entry as /people/{id}); an empty list means none found, null means the register could not be read (retry). Matched as on /people/{id} (full name plus birth month), so only persons with significant control are covered, not directors. bic (every company that has an lei, no extra credit): the BIC codes that the GLEIF BIC-to-LEI mapping, built by SWIFT and updated monthly, lists for the LEI ([] when it has none, null when the company has no lei); an answer that carries a BIC carries SWIFT notice in meta.attribution, keep it with the codes. mic (same rule): the market identifier codes (ISO 10383) that the GLEIF MIC-to-LEI mapping, built by SWIFT and updated about monthly, lists for the LEI; only trading venues and market operators have one, so most companies carry []; its own SWIFT notice goes in meta.attribution after the BIC one. service_address (address, postal_code, city, region: the address for legal notices), parent_company (name, country, identifier, relationship controlling_entity or head_office, source annual_filing, as_of: the controlling entity or foreign head office the company declared), duration_end_date (the end of the term fixed in the bylaws; null when indefinite or not published) and filing_profile (the provenance of values read from the latest annual filing: source, source_label, filing_id, period_end, source_url, reported_status, reported_status_local, auditor_required), every plan, no extra credit, null where unknown, any country can fill them. The register value always comes first; only where it has none do address, postal_code, city, region and business_purpose take the latest filing profile, and the filing phone, mobile and e-mail appear in contacts with data_source annual_filing. Today only Colombia fills them (Superintendencia de Sociedades NIIF cover sheet, companies that file NIIF accounts with it): values as the company declared them at the period end, not checked by the register; reported_status is the own declaration of the company, never written into status. register_url (every company, no extra credit): a link to the company's own page at the official register, never a copy of it; only registers whose public page has a stable address built from the company's number (GB, BE, EE, JP, AU by the ABN, as at 11 Nov 2026), null elsewhere, including registers that need a login or a search form. eu_size_class, eu_size and fiscal_year_end_month (every plan, no extra credit): an INDICATIVE EU size class (micro, small, medium or large of Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC: staff under 10, 50 and 250, and turnover or balance sheet total up to EUR 2m, 10m and 50m, 43m for the balance sheet total) read from the latest annual accounts held (fiscal year 2022 or later) and the register head count; a class, never the figures, with eu_size.range (the classes still possible when the class is null), eu_size.basis, eu_size.autonomy (unverified, or group_member_known) and indicative true. Not a determination that a company is or is not an SME: the partner and linked-enterprise test cannot be applied (a known parent only floors the class; France INSEE category ETI or GE means large, PME at most medium), one year is read, the head count is the accounts average or the register, not annual work units. GB, RO, FR, EE, SE, DK, LV and NO give a class; LT and FI (no head count) a range, or large; null for sole proprietorships (ENK, EI), Brazil, Colombia and every other country. fiscal_year_end_month (1-12) is the month the latest annual accounts end, for every company of those countries with annual accounts held, whatever the fiscal year. holds_real_estate and real_estate (France only; the flag on every plan, the figures from the Professional plan, no extra credit): the real estate a French company holds, from the DGFiP files of premises and parcels held by legal persons (cadastral records, Licence Ouverte 2.0), situation at 1 January of the vintage (2025 first, published 8 to 14 months later: real_estate.situation_date and source_updated give both). holds_real_estate is true when the company is listed, false when its legal form is one the files cover, it existed on 1 January of the vintage and it is not listed, and null for a single-member company, a sole proprietor or another legal form the files do not cover, or a company created after that date; real_estate.availability is listed or not_listed (single-member companies and sole proprietors are not in the files, so not_listed alone does not mean the company holds nothing, and every figure is then null, never zero). Counts and areas only, no address, cadastral reference or holder name: premises_owned (cadastral premises with the right of ownership; a flat, a garage and a cellar count as three, no type or surface), parcels_owned, land_area_m2 (the land area of the parcels in which the company holds the right, not owned area; a parcel held by several companies counts whole for each) with land_by_use, communes, departments and other_rights (usufruct, bare ownership, emphyteusis, building and rehabilitation leases). Below the Professional plan real_estate.figures is plan_required and the figures are null. Null for sole proprietorships (EI), non-diffusible companies and every other country. Source: DGFiP, fichiers des locaux et des parcelles des personnes morales, 2025. public_sector and public_supplier (company detail only, every plan, no extra credit): what the company won from public buyers in the last three years, summed from the awards that procurement_awards and include=procurement list (the same values and flags). contracts_won counts the awards that are not framework agreements (an award is one buyer, one contract or lot, one supplier: a contract won jointly counts once per partner, a contract awarded in lots once per lot); contracts_with_value and total_awarded_eur add the published amounts of those with a usable value, in EUR before VAT where the source says so (an amount flagged as a form default or implausible, and a zero, are left out; a floor, null when none is usable; GB, FI, SE and NO publish a value on only part of their awards; a notice that repeats one total on each of its lots repeats it, and an award that a corrected notice restates is counted again); framework_agreements are counted apart (ceilings, never added to the value); first_award_date, last_award_date, buyers (distinct buyer identifiers as the notices give them) and sme_share over sme_stated_awards (the awards that state whether the winner is an SME: the buyer's declaration in the notice, for France the publisher's size category). null means not found, never "not a supplier": only winners a notice links to a company record of their own country are counted, above each portal's publishing threshold (IE, PL, NO and the TED countries: above the EU thresholds only, the TED ones since November 2023; GB, IE, NO and PL are loaded mostly from notices published since 1 January 2025, so for them the window holds less than three years), and the share linked is lowest for IE and GB. Served for ES, FR, GB, IE, PL, NO, FI, SE, DK, EE, LV, CZ, HR and BE; null for every other country, for sole proprietorships and when the read failed; public_supplier is true or null, never false. Award values, not revenue; as_of is the day of the last refresh, not the date of the newest award (ES, FR, GB, IE, PL and NO are loaded every day, the other countries in periodic loads, so their newest awards can be days to weeks behind), and an award with no date is not counted. financial_flags and growth_3y (Scale plan and above, null on every other plan with a notice in meta.notice, no extra credit): INDICATORS read from the latest annual accounts held, never a rating, a score or a probability of insolvency or default. financial_flags.flags has seven keys, each true, false or null when the accounts lack what it needs (null is never false): negative_equity, loss_two_years, current_ratio_below_1, interest_cover_below_1_5, revenue_down_over_20pct, equity_below_half_capital (equity under half the share capital the balance sheet states, own accounts only) and filed_late (filed after the statutory deadline: GB, SE, DK, EE and FI only); basis names the accounts, which can be up to three years old; GB small companies file no profit and loss account, so their loss and revenue flags are null. growth_3y: revenue_cagr and employees_cagr (average yearly growth over three years, 0.1834 = 18.34% a year) and high_growth (Eurostat: employees up more than 10% a year over the three years, at least 10 employees at the start); staff counts are often missing, and acquisitions and small bases distort growth. As at 27 Oct 2026 the earlier accounts are held for about half or more of the companies in LV, EE and RO, for part of those in FR, DK, FI and SE, and for few in GB, NO and LT. Served for GB, RO, FR, SE, NO, DK, EE, LV, LT and FI; null for sole proprietorships and every other country, and for a company without accounts of the last three fiscal years. Every company object (also search and lookup items) carries `status_as_of` (the latest date the source is known to show the status), `status_basis` (`register_snapshot`, `register_act` for ES and FR, `lei_record` for Germany and the LEI layers, or `unknown`) and `status_warning` (one English sentence, null unless that date is old for its source; a prompt to check the register, never a finding that the company is inactive). Spain and France carry no last-act date on the served record: their status_as_of is the date of the status the register published (null for an active company) and no age warning is given yet.

company_number.description: The register's number for the country (NIF/CIF, SIREN or SIRET, Companies House number, KRS, CVR, ...), instead of id; needs country.

country.description: Country code: ES (Spain, BORME), FR (France, BODACC), GB (UK, Companies House), IE (Ireland, CRO), PL (Poland, KRS), NO (Norway, Brønnøysundregistrene / Enhetsregisteret), FI (Finland, Kaupparekisteri, the Finnish Trade Register), SE (Sweden, Bolagsverket, the Swedish Companies Registration Office), HR (Croatia, Sudski registar, the Croatian court register), BE (Belgium, KBO/BCE, the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises), DK (Denmark, CVR, the Danish Central Business Register), EE (Estonia, the e-Business Register, RIK), SK (Slovakia, RPO, the Register of Legal Entities), CH (Switzerland, Zefix, the Swiss central business name index), LV (Latvia, the Register of Enterprises, Uzņēmumu reģistrs), CY (Cyprus, DRCOR, the Department of the Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property), RO (Romania, ONRC, the National Trade Register Office), LT (Lithuania, JAR, the Register of Legal Entities), CA (Canada, Corporations Canada, federal corporations only), AU (Australia, ASIC and the Australian Business Register), JP (Japan, the National Tax Agency corporate number publication site), IL (Israel, the Corporations Authority), BR (Brazil, CNPJ, Receita Federal), AR (Argentina, the Registro Nacional de Sociedades of the Ministry of Justice, built from the register of legal persons of ARCA, the tax authority; commercial companies only, register-change events and monitoring since 28 Oct 2026, read monthly, none before that date; status from the Inspeccion General de Justicia register of Buenos Aires where it lists the CUIT: active, deregistered or merged, with the baja code and wording in registry_details (no date), otherwise null except liquidation or bankruptcy read from the name; a dissolution alert when a monitored company is first seen deregistered or merged), UA (Ukraine, the Unified State Register of Legal Entities, Individual Entrepreneurs and Public Organisations, EDR, of the Ministry of Justice of Ukraine; commercial legal persons only), RS (Serbia, the Register of Business Entities of the Business Registers Agency, APR; companies only: d.o.o., a.d., o.d. and k.d.; the matični broj is the company number; register-change events and monitoring since the October 2026 launch, read monthly), KR (South Korea, the OpenDART electronic disclosure system of the Financial Supervisory Service; only filers with a commercial company form (주식회사, 유한회사, 유한책임회사, 합자회사, 합명회사), not every Korean company; the OpenDART corporation code, 8 digits, is the company number and business_number= finds a company by its business registration number; the status is always unknown and there is no dissolution date; no officers, no shareholders, no share capital, no VAT number, no financial statements and no insolvency notices; register-change events (name, legal form, address) none before the first South Korean load, no monitoring; updated every business day. Contains data from the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) of the Republic of Korea, OpenDART electronic disclosure system (https://opendart.fss.or.kr), public data under the Act on Promotion of the Provision and Use of Public Data. Adapted by Prometiam; not an official FSS extract.), SI (Slovenia, the Business Register of Slovenia, PRS, of AJPES, from its open list; companies only: d.o.o., d.d., d.n.o., k.d. and SE; the matična številka is the company number; the status is read only from the bankruptcy or liquidation marker in the name; no dates, activity code, share capital, VAT number, officers or insolvency notices; financial statements (company_financials) only for listed companies (ESEF reports) and the banks of the EBA Transparency Exercise 2025; register-change events and monitoring, none before the first load in November 2026, read about every two weeks), MT (Malta, company records from the open data of the Malta Business Registry (MBR): the register number with its prefix (for example C 51037) is the company number and the LEI a second identifier; private and public limited companies, Societas Europea and partnerships only, so funds (SICAVs), overseas companies and European Economic Interest Groupings are never served; status active, in_dissolution, deregistered or merged; the NACE class only where the register states an activity; no officers, no share capital, no VAT number (a vat search is refused) and no insolvency notices; financial statements (company_financials) only for listed companies (ESEF reports) and the banks of the EBA Transparency Exercise 2025; register-change events and monitoring, none before the Malta launch; updated daily. Credit: Contains data from the Malta Business Registry (MBR), "Basic Company Information" open data, published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (CC BY 4.0). Adapted by Prometiam (one record per company; names, addresses, dates and statuses normalised); not an official register extract. Contains LEI data from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), available under CC0 1.0.), GR (Greece, company records from the General Commercial Registry (G.E.MI.): the 12-digit GEMI number (a head office ends in 000) is the company number, the AFM is identifiers.afm and the LEI a further identifier; the VAT number is EL plus the AFM, built by rule and not confirmed; companies and cooperatives in every status only, never branches, sole proprietorships, civil companies, joint ventures, European Economic Interest Groupings, energy communities or co-ownerships; the NACE class read off the activity code; no registration date, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no shareholders, no filings and no insolvency notices; financial statements (company_financials) from the balance-sheet announcements GEMI publishes, for AE, IKE and EPE companies, read gradually, largest companies first, so most have none yet; register-change events (none before 24 Oct 2026) and monitoring; new registrations read every day and the whole register every seven days. Credit: Contains data from the General Commercial Registry (Γ.Ε.ΜΗ.), Central GEMI Service, Hellenic Federation of Chambers of Commerce (KEEE), available under the ODC-BY 1.0 licence (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/odc-by). Adapted by Prometiam. Contains LEI data from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), available under CC0 1.0.), NC (New Caledonia, the list of active enterprises of the Ridet, published every quarter by the ISEE, the statistics office: a statistical directory, not a commercial register, and not the whole population of legal units; companies only (SARL, EURL, SELARL, SAS, SA, SNC, civil companies, GIE, cooperatives), never associations, sole traders, public bodies or foreign legal persons; the RID7, seven digits with their leading zeros, is the company number and an establishment’s ten-digit Ridet number is reduced to it; status active, or deregistered with no date; commune and province only; the NAF rev. 2 activity code; no street address, no founding or registration date, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no VAT number (a vat search is refused), no financial statements and no insolvency notices; no register-change events and no monitoring; updated every quarter. Credit: Contains data from the Institut de la statistique et des études économiques de Nouvelle-Calédonie (ISEE), Ridet, liste des entreprises actives, original data downloaded from www.isee.nc, updated 21 October 2026, under the Licence Ouverte. Adapted by Prometiam (companies only, activity code and legal form normalised); not the whole population of legal units of New Caledonia and not an official register extract.), PE (Peru, a partial list of the legal entities that sold to the Peruvian state since 2003, from the open contracting data of the OECE, not Peru's company register; a company that never sold to the state is absent, and sole traders (RUC 10, 15 and 17) and natural persons are never served; the RUC is the company number, 11 digits starting 20 with SUNAT's modulo 11 check digit enforced; served: name, RUC and the street where the data gives one (few do; city, region and postal code never); no status (null), no founding or registration date, no legal form code, no activity code, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no contacts, no VAT number (a vat search is refused), no financial statements and no insolvency notices; no register-change events and no monitoring; updated monthly, with a lag (the newest awards are not in yet), and the name and address are those of the newest award. Credit: Contains data from the Organismo Especializado para las Contrataciones Públicas Eficientes (OECE) of Peru, the legal entities that sold to the Peruvian state since 2003, published through the Open Contracting Data Registry (https://data.open-contracting.org/en/publication/135) under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) licence. Adapted by Prometiam (legal entities only, one record per company); not Peru's company register and not an official extract.), HN (Honduras, a partial list of the legal entities that sold to the Honduran state since 2005, from the open contracting data of the ONCAE, not Honduras's company register; a company that never sold to the state is absent, and national identity numbers (people) and the ONCAE's internal codes are never served; the RTN is the company number, 14 digits with a 9 in the fifth place and no check digit; served: name, RTN and the street line as filed (no city or region); no status (null), no founding or registration date, no legal form code, no activity code, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no contacts, no VAT number (a vat search is refused), no financial statements and no insolvency notices; no register-change events and no monitoring; updated monthly, with a lag (the newest awards are not in yet), and the name and address are those of the newest award. Credit: Contains data from the Oficina Normativa de Contratación y Adquisiciones del Estado (ONCAE) of Honduras, the legal entities that sold to the Honduran state since 2005, published through the Open Contracting Data Registry (https://data.open-contracting.org/en/publication/122) under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) licence. Adapted by Prometiam (legal entities only, one record per company); not Honduras's company register and not an official extract.), GT (Guatemala, a partial list of the legal entities that bid to or sold to the Guatemalan state, from the Guatecompras open data, not Guatemala's company register; a company that only bid is served too, one that never bid is absent, and natural persons and co-ownerships of persons are never served; the NIT is the company number, written NNNNNNN-D with a modulo 11 check digit (K allowed) enforced; served: name, NIT, street, locality (city), department (region) and the legal-entity type as text (legal_form_full); no status (null), no founding or registration date, no legal form code, no activity code, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no contacts, no VAT number (a vat search is refused), no financial statements and no insolvency notices; no register-change events and no monitoring; updated monthly, with a lag (the newest awards are not in yet), and the name and address are those of the newest award. Credit: Contains data from Guatecompras, Ministerio de Finanzas Públicas of Guatemala, the legal entities that bid to or sold to the Guatemalan state, published as open contracting data (https://ocds.guatecompras.gt/descarga-datos) under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) licence. Adapted by Prometiam (legal entities only, one record per company); not Guatemala's company register and not an official extract.), MD (Moldova, State Register of legal units, kept by the Public Services Agency (ASP) and published as open data: companies only (SRL, SA, SNC, SC), the 13-digit IDNO is the company number; no officers, share capital, VAT number, activity code or financials; register-change events and monitoring; updated weekly), UY (Uruguay, RUPE, the register of state suppliers of ARCE: a partial list, not the company register; the 12-digit RUT is the company number; legal entities registered as state suppliers only; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials; updated monthly), DO (Dominican Republic, MICM open data on certified MIPYMES: a partial list, not the company register; the 9-digit RNC is the company number; name only, no address; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials; the served list is shared under the ODbL licence, share-alike; updated monthly), NZ (New Zealand, the Charities Register of Charities Services: registered and deregistered charities that are legal entities, not companies and not the company register; the NZBN or the CC charity number is the company number; no events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials; updated weekly), BG (Bulgaria, the open contracting data of the Public Procurement Agency: companies that sold to the state in 2026 only, a partial list, not the commercial register; the 9-digit EIK is the company number; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials), GE (Georgia, the open contracting data of the State Procurement Agency: a frozen history of state suppliers to June 2019, never updated again, not the company register; the 9-digit identification code is the company number; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials), TZ (Tanzania, the open contracting data of the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority: a partial list of state suppliers as at February 2026, nothing added since, not the company register; the BRELA number is the company number; shared under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence, share-alike; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials), ZM (Zambia, the open contracting data of the Zambia Public Procurement Authority: a partial list of state suppliers, not the company register; the 12-digit PACRA number is the company number; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials; updated monthly), EC (Ecuador, the company directory of the Superintendencia de Companias, Valores y Seguros joined on the RUC with the Catastro RUC of the Servicio de Rentas Internas; limited companies of the SCVS list only; the RUC is the company number; register-change events and monitoring none before the Ecuador launch, read monthly), CL (Chile, the Registro de Empresas y Sociedades (RES), Ministerio de Economía, Fomento y Turismo; only the companies registered under the simplified regime of Ley 20.659 since 2013, not the whole Chilean register; the RUT is the company number; no register-change events and no monitoring), CO (Colombia, RUES, Confecámaras), SG (Singapore, ACRA), TW (Taiwan, GCIS and the Ministry of Finance), CZ (Czech Republic, the public register of the Ministry of Justice and the Czech Statistical Office RES), DE (Germany, LEI-registered entities and energy-market register companies, not the commercial register), NL (Netherlands, LEI-registered entities with a KVK number, not the Dutch commercial register), MX (Mexico, LEI-registered entities and the companies of INEGI's DENUE directory of economic units, not the Mexican company register), or US (United States: state business registers, SEC EDGAR and GLEIF). Ireland, Finland, Sweden, Croatia, Belgium, Denmark, Estonia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Latvia, Cyprus, Romania, Lithuania, Canada, Australia, Japan, Israel, Singapore, Colombia, Taiwan, Germany, the Netherlands, Ukraine, Serbia, Slovenia, Malta, South Korea, Greece, New Caledonia, Peru, Honduras, Guatemala, Moldova, Uruguay, the Dominican Republic, New Zealand, Bulgaria, Georgia, Tanzania, Zambia, Ecuador, Chile, Mexico, Argentina, Brazil and the United States are company-level (companies only). Norway has companies and officers; the Czech Republic has companies and, as appointments on the company record (no extra credit), its officers and partners: the statutory body, administrative and supervisory boards, control commission, partners (with the deposit and share where the register gives one amount and a percentage or fraction), the sole shareholder of a joint-stock company, procurators and liquidators the register lists today, with the function in Czech; a natural person is the name as published and the month and year of birth only (no day, birth number, address or nationality); a company member carries its name, IČO and foreign register number; no officer history (a member who leaves drops out at the next read); no person records, no search by officer name and no director network; representatives of company members, the way of acting, pledges and insolvency administrators are not served; officer changes are not register-change events; companies deleted before 2026 have no officers; an empty list means the register lists no such member; updated daily; Poland has companies and officers on the company record (management board, supervisory board, proxies and the representation rule from the KRS full extract; natural persons are masked by the register itself, so no person records, and the list is filled progressively); Ireland, Poland and Norway have register-change events only, from 14 Oct 2026 (no gazette). Finland, Sweden, Belgium, Croatia, Denmark, Estonia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Latvia, Cyprus, Romania, Lithuania, Canada, Australia, Japan, Israel, Singapore, Colombia, Taiwan, Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, Ukraine, Serbia, Slovenia, South Korea, Malta, Ecuador, Argentina, Greece, Moldova, Brazil, the United States and every LEI layer have register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address; share capital for HR, EE, SK, CH, LV, LT, TW, BR and CZ; for Ukraine name, status, legal form and share capital, no registered address; for Serbia the address is the municipality), dated when the change first appears in the register data (for the United States, the weekly read of the registers that first sees it) and none before 2026-09-30 (for a country or LEI layer added later, none before its first load), and monitoring (not South Korea). Company records from the Finnish Trade Register: legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal. Corporate insolvency notices are linked by business ID. Sweden: Company records from the Swedish Companies Registration Office (Bolagsverket): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal, and sole traders (enskild näringsverksamhet) are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (konkurs, företagsrekonstruktion, ackordsförhandling; weekly, no court or case number) are linked by organisationsnummer. Croatia: Company records from the Croatian court register (Sudski registar): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal, and sole traders (trgovac pojedinac) are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (court decisions, with court and case number where the register states them) are linked by MBS. Belgium: Company records from the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no insolvency notices (Belgium is not an insolvency market: a bankruptcy shows in the company status and in its register-change events), and enterprises of natural persons (eenmanszaak / entreprise individuelle) are never served. Denmark: Company records from the Danish Central Business Register (CVR): legal name, legal form, status (including the register's bankruptcy state), registered address, activity code and dates; no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no share capital, and sole proprietorships (enkeltmandsvirksomhed) and estates are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (konkurs and tvangsakkord from CVR credit information: one notice per proceeding, dated by the decision that opened it, with the latest stage of the proceeding; no court or case number) are linked by CVR number. Estonia: Company records from the Estonian e-Business Register (RIK): legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation and bankruptcy), registered address, activity code (EMTAK 2008 or 2025, per company) and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers and no registry-compliance signal. Its bankruptcy declarations are served as insolvency notices. Sole traders (FIE) are never served, and the VAT number (KMKR) is searchable with `vat=`. Slovakia: Company records from the Slovak Register of Legal Entities (RPO): legal name, legal form, status (including bankruptcy (konkurz) and restructuring), registered address, activity code (SK NACE Rev. 2.1) and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no insolvency notices. Commercial legal persons only (no associations, foundations or other non-commercial entities); VAT number from the Slovak Financial Administration list of VAT payers (null for a company not on the list; a `vat` search by IČ DPH finds it); sole traders and other natural persons are never served. Romania: Company records from the National Trade Register Office (ONRC): legal name, legal form, status (including dissolution, liquidation, insolvency, reorganisation, bankruptcy and deregistration), registered address with the county, CAEN activity codes, the J registration number and EUID, and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no share capital and no insolvency notices. Natural persons and sole traders are never served. The CUI (2 to 10 digits, check digit advisory) is the company_number; the Romanian VAT number (RO plus the CUI, built by rule) is searchable with `vat=`. Cyprus: Company records from the Department of the Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property (DRCOR): legal name, legal form, status (including strike-off pending, voluntary and compulsory liquidation and administration), registered address with the district and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no activity code, no share capital, no VAT number (a vat search is refused) and no insolvency notices. Companies and overseas companies only; trade names and partnerships are never served. Latvia: Company records from the Register of Enterprises of the Republic of Latvia (Uzņēmumu reģistrs): legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation, insolvency and legal protection proceedings), registered address with the region, share capital, previous names and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no activity code. Its Insolvency Register proceedings are served as insolvency notices. Individual merchants and other natural persons are never served. The registration number (11 digits, an LV prefix optional, with a mod-11 check that is enforced) is the company_number, and the Latvian VAT number (LV plus the registration number) is searchable with `vat=`. Switzerland: Company records from Zefix, the Swiss central business name index: legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation), registered address with the canton and business purpose; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no activity code (the register publishes no NOGA code). Legal entities and branches only; sole proprietorships (Einzelunternehmen) and other natural persons are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (SHAB) are linked by UID where the notice names the debtor's UID. Commercial-register publications of the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SHAB) are served as gazette events for Swiss legal entities and branches, from publications of 1 January 2024 (new entry, change of name, seat, address, purpose, capital, legal form, auditor, board or signatories, merger, liquidation, bankruptcy, deletion), dated by the publication date, linked by UID, with the SHAB publication as notice_url; the notice text and the names of board members and signatories are never served (a board or signatory change says only that persons changed). The gazette events are a summary derived from the SOGC publications; the publication linked as notice_url is the authoritative text. The UID with its MWST, TVA or IVA suffix is searchable with `vat=`. United States: there is no national register, so the API serves company records from the business registers of New York, Colorado, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, Florida, Iowa, the District of Columbia, Texas, Oregon and Massachusetts (state open data and public records) plus SEC filers (EDGAR) and LEI holders (GLEIF) from every state, Delaware included, as one record per state registration (domestic or foreign); numbers look like NY-4424185, CO-20091096973, DE-10684990, CIK-0000320193 or LEI-… and identifiers also carry the SEC CIK, the EIN of SEC filers and the LEI; New York, Pennsylvania, Iowa and Oregon publish active entities only (Florida serves active and inactive entities: profit corporations, limited liability companies, limited partnerships and non-profit corporations, domestic and foreign; the District of Columbia serves every status, a closed one with its reason, and Iowa the home-office address, neither with registered agents or beneficial owners; Texas serves franchise tax taxpayers that hold a Secretary of State file number, from the file of the Comptroller of Public Accounts and not the Secretary of State register, forfeited and closed ones with their status; Oregon serves limited liability companies, business, professional and non-profit corporations, limited partnerships, limited liability partnerships and cooperatives with the principal place of business as address (the mailing address for limited partnerships, which have none), never assumed business names (trade names), business trusts, reserved names or acts of government, and has no registered agents or authorized representatives; Massachusetts serves every status (active, dissolved, revoked, withdrawn, and inactive where no reason is given), domestic and foreign business, professional, benefit and non-profit corporations, limited liability companies, limited partnerships, registered limited liability partnerships, co-operatives and the Chapter 180 and special-statute corporations, from the public-record extract of the Corporations Division (19 Oct 2026; refreshed, with its change events, only when the Division supplies a newer extract), not an official register extract, never trade names (foreign DBAs), voluntary associations, trusts or corporations sole, and has no officers or resident agents) and the SEC gives no legal status; updated weekly; company-level (no officers and no registry-compliance signal, with register-change events (dated by the weekly read) and monitoring), no VAT number (a `vat` search is refused), sole proprietorships never served, and not every US company. US insolvency notices are on insolvency_search and are not linked to the company records. US sources: New York Department of State, Colorado Secretary of State, Connecticut Secretary of the State, Pennsylvania Department of State (open data), Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations (public records), Iowa Secretary of State (CC BY 4.0), District of Columbia Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (CC BY 4.0), Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts (franchise tax data), Oregon Secretary of State, Corporation Division (open data), Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, Corporations Division (public-record extract of 19 Oct 2026; not an official register extract and not endorsed by the Secretary), SEC EDGAR, GLEIF (CC0). Lithuania: Company records from the Register of Legal Entities (JAR): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Company status includes liquidation, bankruptcy and restructuring; there are no insolvency notices. Activity codes follow NACE Rev. 2.1 (EVRK 2.1, class level; the 6-digit code is in registry_details). Share capital is held for UAB and AB only. VAT numbers come from the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI) list. Sole proprietorships, partnerships (KUB, TUB), branches, state enterprises and non-commercial bodies are never served. Credit: Contains data from the Register of Legal Entities (JAR), Registrų centras, the State Data Agency (Statistics Lithuania) and the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI), CC BY 4.0. Adapted by Prometiam. Canada: Company records from Corporations Canada (Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Federal corporations only (Canada Business Corporations Act, Canada Cooperatives Act and the repealed Canada Corporations Act Part I and Cooperative Associations Act); provincial and territorial corporations, not-for-profit corporations and boards of trade are not in the register. There is no insolvency, liquidation or bankruptcy status (that is the Office of the Superintendent of Bankruptcy and the courts), no activity code, share capital or VAT number. The Business Number is searchable with business_number=, and a corporation's other names are in registry_details. Credit: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Corporations Canada, Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada). Adapted by Prometiam. Australia: Company records from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) and the Australian Business Register (ABR): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated weekly. Proprietary, public and foreign companies (ACN and ARBN) only; associations, cooperatives, other bodies, individuals and sole traders are never served. The register gives the state and the postcode, not a street address. ASIC does not separate liquidation from administration, so external administration shows as in_administration and there is no in_liquidation status; there are no insolvency notices. No activity code or share capital. The VAT number is the ABN when the ABN is active and registered for GST; an ABN is searchable with abn= and a GST-registered one with vat=. Data are licensed CC BY 3.0 AU (no sublicensing): the credit and licence link travel with every answer. Credit: Contains data from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) Company Dataset and the Australian Business Register (ABN Bulk Extract), licensed CC BY 3.0 AU (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). Adapted by Prometiam (joined, normalised, status derived). Japan: Company records from the National Tax Agency corporate number publication site: legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day, with a monthly full reconciliation. Companies (kabushiki, godo, gomei, goshi and tokurei yugen kaisha) and registered foreign companies only; national and local government bodies, associations and other corporations are never served. Status is active, deregistered or merged (with the successor's number): the register publishes no liquidation or insolvency state and there are no insolvency notices; the employee count, share capital, date of establishment (served as the founding date), website and industry division only for the companies whose figures gBizINFO (METI) holds, each with its source in registry_details and never a value a company typed itself (the industry is a JSIC division: no NACE or ISIC class). The VAT number is the T-number (T and the 13-digit corporate number) from the register of qualified invoice issuers kept by the National Tax Agency, served while the registration is in force; it is null for a company that is not registered, whose registration was cancelled or has expired, or that pays consumption tax without being a qualified invoice issuer (null does not mean the company is not a taxpayer). The registration date is the date the corporate number was assigned and is null for companies that carry only the 5 October 2015 designation. Names are in Japanese; the English name, the kana reading and a romanised name are in registry_details. A search in Latin letters also meets the romanised name and, for about 3,600 companies (mostly large and listed), the English names GLEIF holds (CC0; name_latin serves one where the register holds no English name, name_en stays the National Tax Agency name). Credit: Source: National Tax Agency Corporate Number Publication Site (https://www.houjin-bangou.nta.go.jp/). Edited and processed by Prometiam; not a product of the National Tax Agency or the State. 出典：国税庁法人番号公表サイト（https://www.houjin-bangou.nta.go.jp/）。Prometiamが編集・加工して作成（国税庁が作成した情報ではありません）。 Source: National Tax Agency Qualified Invoice Issuer Public Disclosure Site (https://www.invoice-kohyo.nta.go.jp/). Edited and processed by Prometiam; not a product of the National Tax Agency. 出典：国税庁適格請求書発行事業者公表サイト（国税庁）（https://www.invoice-kohyo.nta.go.jp/）。Prometiamが編集・加工して作成（国税庁が作成した情報ではありません）。 Israel: Company records from the Israeli Corporations Authority (Ministry of Justice): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Israeli and registered foreign companies only; partnerships, cooperative societies, non-profit associations and sole traders are other registers and are not served. Company status includes liquidation, receivership, restructuring and insolvency proceedings; there are no insolvency notices. Names are in Hebrew, with the English name in registry_details where the register holds one. A search in Latin letters also meets, for about 2,000 more companies, the English names GLEIF holds (CC0; name_latin serves the best of them, never a trading name). No activity code, share capital or VAT number. Credit: Contains information from the Israeli Corporations Authority, Ministry of Justice, via data.gov.il (used under the data.gov.il terms of use). Adapted by Prometiam; not an official register extract. Brazil: Company records from the Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica (CNPJ), Receita Federal do Brasil: legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated monthly (the Receita publishes one full file a month). Commercial legal persons only: limited companies (LTDA), corporations (S.A.), simple societies, single-member limited companies (EIRELI), public companies and mixed-capital companies, and cooperatives; sole traders (empresário individual, MEI included), non-profit entities, branches of foreign companies and every other natural-person form are never served. One record per CNPJ root, with the head office's 14-character CNPJ (shown 00.000.000/0001-91; the 8-digit root finds it too); branches are not served. Status is active, suspended, inapta (served as active_strike_off_pending), deregistered or merged; judicial recovery, bankruptcy, liquidation and intervention are read from the register's special situation, and there are no insolvency notices. The activity code is CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 (BR-CNAE-2.3), not a NACE code; a NACE Rev. 2 class (or only the NACE division) is derived from it through ISIC Rev. 4 where the official tables allow, and nace_derived marks it; the secondary codes are in registry_details. No VAT number (a vat search is refused), and no partners, officers or contacts. Credit: Contains data from the Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica (CNPJ), Receita Federal do Brasil, published as open data (CC BY). Adapted by Prometiam. Colombia: Company records from Confecámaras (RUES, the Colombian chambers of commerce): legal name, legal form, status, identifiers and dates, the legal representative (name only, never an identification number; no person search or director network), the supplier-register (RUP) number as identifier type rup while registered there, the end of the term of the company (duration_end_date, null when indefinite); no registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated monthly: the source's own update date is data_as_of and is in the credit. Companies of the commercial register only (S.A.S., Ltda., S.A., S. en C., S.C.A., collective companies, single-person companies (E.U.) and branches of foreign companies); natural persons, non-profit entities, cooperatives and public bodies are never served. The register itself has no address, share capital, contact or VAT number (a vat search is refused); for a company that files NIIF accounts with the Superintendencia de Sociedades, address, service_address, phone, mobile, e-mail, purpose clause and parent_company come from the cover sheet of its latest annual filing, as the company declared them at the period end and not checked by the register (filing_profile names the filing; fiscal years from 2023). The register has no liquidation state: liquidation, judicial liquidation and reorganisation are read from the company name and served as the status, and a cancelled registration is deregistered or merged. The registration may not be current although it reads active: last_renewal_year in registry_details is the last year it was renewed. company_name is the name without those markers and name_as_registered is the name as published. The activity code is the CIIU Rev.4 A.C. 4-digit code (CO-CIIU-REV4-AC), not a NACE code; a NACE Rev. 2 class (or only the NACE division) is derived from it through ISIC Rev. 4 where the official tables allow, and nace_derived marks it. No insolvency notices. SECOP II public contracts to companies by NIT are served as procurement awards, in pesos with no euro amount (read amount_original and currency; min_amount never matches them), and administrative fines imposed by a contracting entity on a public contract (SECOP I) as the risk flag procurement_fine, not a court judgment. The records, the filing-profile values, the contracts and the fines are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike). Credit: Contains data from the Superintendencia de Sociedades (Estados Financieros NIIF, Caratula), via the Portal de Datos Abiertos www.datos.gov.co, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Contains SECOP II data (Agencia Nacional de Contratacion Publica - Colombia Compra Eficiente, datos.gov.co), CC BY-SA 4.0. Contains Multas y Sanciones SECOP I data (Agencia Nacional de Contratacion Publica - Colombia Compra Eficiente), CC BY-SA 4.0. Contains data from the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (CUIF), via www.datos.gov.co, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Contains data from Confecámaras (RUES, Registro Único Empresarial y Social), via the Portal de Datos Abiertos www.datos.gov.co, last updated on the date shown in data_as_of, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Adapted by Prometiam; the adapted Colombian records are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0. Singapore: Company records from the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated monthly. Local companies, limited liability partnerships (LLP) and registered foreign company branches only; sole proprietorships, general partnerships and limited partnerships are never served. Status includes liquidation, judicial management and receivership, and a struck-off, dissolved or amalgamated company is deregistered or merged; the corporate insolvency notices of the Singapore Government Gazette are served separately (/insolvency/search?country=SG) and linked to the record by the UEN. The register publishes no cessation date, share capital, GST (VAT) number (a vat search is refused), region or officers. The activity code is SSIC 2020 (5 digits, SG-SSIC-2020; a legacy 4-digit code carries no scheme); a NACE Rev. 2 class (or only the NACE division) is derived from it through ISIC Rev. 4 where the official tables allow, and nace_derived marks it. The annual return and accounts-due dates are in registry_details as published. API use of the data is licensed, not a right to the data itself. Credit: Contains information from ACRA Information on Corporate Entities and Entities Registered with ACRA accessed on the date shown in data_as_of from the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) via data.gov.sg, which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence). Adapted by Prometiam; not an official ACRA extract. Taiwan: Company records from the Ministry of Economic Affairs (GCIS) and the Ministry of Finance (Fiscal Information Agency): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated daily. Limited companies, companies limited by shares, unlimited companies, limited partnership companies and Taiwan branches of foreign companies only; sole proprietorships, partnerships, domestic branches, cooperatives, associations and representative offices are never served. Names and addresses are in Chinese (the register publishes no English name; the English name of a company registered as an importer or exporter with the Bureau of Foreign Trade, about one in five since 21 Oct 2026, is in registry_details.name_en and is searchable in Latin letters). The responsible person is not served. Status includes dissolution, reorganisation, receivership and bankruptcy. The VAT number is the unified business number where the company is in the Ministry of Finance tax file (searchable with vat=), else null. The activity code is the Ministry of Finance tax industry code (6 digits, TW-TAX-SIC), which is not a NACE code, and the other codes of the file are in secondary_activity_codes. The check digit of the number is advisory. No officers; no insolvency notices. Credit: Contains data from the Ministry of Economic Affairs (Department of Commerce, GCIS; International Trade Administration, English names) and the Ministry of Finance (Fiscal Information Agency), Republic of China (Taiwan), released under the Open Government Data License, version 1.0 (https://data.gov.tw/license). Adapted by Prometiam, not a certified register extract. Czech Republic: Company records from the Czech public register (Veřejný rejstřík), kept by the regional courts and published by the Ministry of Justice as open data, with the region (kraj) and the activity code from the Czech Statistical Office Register of Economic Entities (RES): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, share capital, identifiers and dates; the officers and partners as appointments on the company record (see the country list) and no registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form, registered address and share capital, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load, October 2026) and monitoring are available. Updated daily. Commercial legal persons only (s.r.o., a.s., v.o.s., k.s., cooperatives, SE, SCE and EEIG); sole traders (OSVČ) and every other natural person, associations, foundations, trust funds, owners associations (SVJ) and branches are never served. Status includes liquidation, insolvency, bankruptcy and restructuring; there are no insolvency notices (the Czech Republic is not one of the sixteen insolvency markets) and no financial statements. No VAT number: a vat search is refused. The activity code is CZ-NACE 2025. The IČO has eight digits and its check digit is advisory, so companies whose IČO fails it are served. The registering court and file number (for example B 1581, Městský soud v Praze) are in registry_details. Credit: Contains data from the public registers of the Czech Republic (Ministry of Justice, ISVR open data) and the Czech Statistical Office (RES, CC BY 4.0). Adapted by Prometiam. Netherlands (NL): LEI-registered entities with a KVK number (GLEIF golden copy, CC0 1.0), not the Dutch commercial register (Handelsregister, KVK); company number = the 8-digit KVK number, lei a second identifier; BV, NV, SE, cooperatives, SCE, OWM, CV and VOF only, no sole proprietorships, foundations, associations, public bodies, funds or branches; no officers, share capital, activity code or VAT number; financial statements (company_financials) only for the banks of the EBA Transparency Exercise 2025 (headline figures at 31 December 2024); register-change events (none before 30 Oct 2026) and monitoring. Credit: Contains LEI data from GLEIF, available under CC0 1.0. LEI-registered entities only; not an extract of the Dutch commercial register (Handelsregister, KVK). Germany (DE): LEI-registered entities (Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation, GLEIF golden copy), plus companies listed in the energy market register (Marktstammdatenregister, Bundesnetzagentur) with their commercial-register entry that no LEI record holds; not the German commercial register (Handelsregister). The second source is a partial layer declared by the market actors and not checked against the commercial register: status null (local_status unknown), no founding date, no register-change events; registry_details.source is gleif or mastr. Company records only: the company number is the 20-character LEI (ISO 17442 check) or, for the energy market register, the commercial-register entry with the court (HRB12653/FRANKFURT-AM-MAIN), searchable with company_number, lei, or register_number (HRB12653, optional register_court); no officers, share capital, activity code or VAT number (a vat search is refused), no registry-compliance signal and no financial statements; register-change events for the LEI-registered entities (name, status, legal form, registered address, none before the first load, October 2026) and monitoring are available. Updated daily. GmbH, UG (haftungsbeschränkt), AG, KGaA, SE, OHG, KG (including GmbH & Co. KG), eG and PartG only; sole traders (e.K.) and other natural persons, GbR, associations (e.V.), foundations, public-law bodies, funds and branches are never served. Status is active, deregistered or merged; the LEI's own renewal status is registry_details.lei_status; the register court, register type and number (for example Amtsgericht München, HRB) are in registry_details. German corporate insolvency notices are served separately (Germany is one of the sixteen insolvency markets) and are not linked to these records. Credit: Contains LEI data from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), available under CC0 1.0. Not an extract of the German commercial register (Handelsregister). Energy market register records also carry: Contains data from the Marktstammdatenregister of the Bundesnetzagentur (https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStR/Datendownload), licensed under the Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0 (dl-de/by-2-0, https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0). Data changed: selected, joined and normalised by Prometiam. Mexico (MX): two sources, one record per company. (1) LEI holders (GLEIF golden copy, CC0 1.0): the company number is the LEI (also lei=), with register-change events and monitoring. (2) The companies of the DENUE directory of INEGI (Mexico's national statistics institute). DENUE is a statistical directory of economic units, not the Mexican company register and not a list of all Mexican companies. A unit is served as a company only when it carries a razón social and shows evidence of being a company's (a legal form in the name, a word that says business, a second unit under one INEGI enterprise code, or a match with an LEI holder); natural persons, public bodies, public-sector schools, associations, funds, trusts, branches and sole establishments are screened out, not guaranteed out. For a company only DENUE lists: the name as INEGI publishes it (since the 11/2026 edition most names carry the legal form, and legal_form is set only where the name carries one); status null (local_status unknown); no founding date, age or dissolution date; the head-office address with postal code, municipality and locality (registry_details.address_basis); the activity as the head-office unit's SCIAN 2018 code with INEGI's title (activity_code_scheme MX-SCIAN-2018; no NACE, ISIC or NAICS code is derived); employee_band, the size band of the largest unit (a floor for the company, never a head count); registry_details.establishments, the units listed under the name (can undercount); registry_details.denue_listed_since (not a founding date); the website only where DENUE gives a plausible host name; source_provider INEGI. No officers, share capital, VAT number (a vat search is refused), financial statements, insolvency notices or register-change events, and monitoring raises sanctions matches only. The company number of such a company is E plus INEGI's four-digit enterprise code, a dash and eight hexadecimal digits (E0042-0A1B2C3D), or U plus INEGI's unit id (U1001): an identifier of this API, not an INEGI or tax number, and not promised stable until a second INEGI edition has been compared; company_number takes it as well as an LEI. An LEI holder that is also in DENUE keeps GLEIF's data (registry_details.source stays gleif) and gains the DENUE fields. INEGI publishes the directory about twice a year (registry_details.denue_edition). Credit: Fuente: INEGI, Directorio Estadístico Nacional de Unidades Económicas (DENUE) 11/2026. Adapted by Prometiam; not an INEGI product and not endorsed by INEGI. LEI records: Contains LEI data from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), available under CC0 1.0; not an extract of the Mexican company register. Defaults to first country in the API key allowlist.

id.description: Prometiam internal company ID (integer). Omit it and give country and company_number to look the company up by its register number.

include.description: Comma-separated extra blocks: procurement, insolvency, financials, lei, risk_flags, structure, metrics, securities, country_risk, charges — or all (all adds lei and risk_flags; name procurement, insolvency, financials, structure, metrics and securities and country_risk explicitly). structure adds corporate_structure: the direct and ultimate parent as reported to GLEIF (Level 2, CC0), and subsidiaries, the first 100 companies that report it to GLEIF as their direct parent (the largest sub-groups first, with count and truncated; only subsidiaries that hold an LEI and report their parent, so a floor; the whole group: GET /companies/{id}/group), for a company of any live country that carries an LEI (null with a meta.notice when none is linked: not reported, not no parent). For a company of Estonia, Great Britain, Latvia, Norway or Slovakia the block also carries register_ownership from the register, legal entities only (natural persons are never stored or served): shareholders (EE, LV), sole_shareholder (SK: the sole shareholder of an a.s.; EE and LV: a shareholder holding 100 %), partners (SK: the partners of an s.r.o.), auditors, accountants and unlimited_liability_partners (NO), each {name, identifier, country, company_id, share_pct, capital_amount, currency, since}, and holdings, the stakes the company holds in companies of the same register (the companies whose register names it as shareholder or partner, in force; {count, items, truncated}, at most 100, the largest share first, each item also with status and kind), with as_of, source and credit; it is returned even when no LEI is linked. An empty list means this register shows no legal-entity relation of that kind that we hold, never that the company has no owner, auditor or partner; share_pct is null where the source gives no share. EE and LV give shareholders only, NO no shareholders and no dates, SK no share figures. GB gives significant_control: the legal entities (companies, LLPs, public bodies, overseas entities) that Companies House lists as persons with significant control and that are still in force, each with control {shares_band, voting_band, natures} as the register states it (bands 25-50, 50-75 and 75-100 %, or over 25 % for an overseas entity's owner; never a percentage, so share_pct is null; a PSC filed without a register number has no identifier), and in holdings the companies that name this one as such a controller; individual controllers, PSC statements and entries the register withholds are never served, and an empty list is not 'no owner'. Credit: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Companies House, UK. No extra credit. For a Spanish company the block is returned even without an LEI and carries register_ownership: the sole shareholder named by the BORME sole-shareholder notices since 2009 (companies only; a natural person is never stored or served; null sole_shareholder means no notice names a company, not that there is no owner), the ultimate owner, the foreign parent of a branch (NIF W) and the companies it solely owns, all figures floors; credit: Based on data from the Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado (BORME). corporate_structure.group_exposure (inside the same block, rebuilt nightly) says what state the parents (GLEIF direct and ultimate parent; for Spain the sole shareholder and the ultimate owner) and the subsidiaries are in: insolvency_notice (a corporate insolvency notice linked to the company number), closed (a closed register status), sanctions_match (the party's name is a near-exact match of a listed company name or alias, tested in both directions; beta: a prompt to look, not a finding) and lei_status (LAPSED is an unpaid LEI renewal, not distress); true, false or null for not looked up (a party that is not a company record we hold has no number to link a notice to). Only LEI groups and Spanish sole-shareholder chains, plus the register owners below; GLEIF parents are self-reported; no ownership percentages for the LEI and Spanish parents; null until the nightly build covers the company. Group exposure also screens the companies registered as owners of the company in EE, LV, SK and NO (CZ and PL partners): legal entities only, never people; a name match is a prompt to look, not a finding; every register owner is screened by name alone and is only ever a possible match (sanctions_tier possible_match, sanctions_match false: sanctions_tier is match, possible_match, none_found or not_checked); at most 200 parents are listed (parents_truncated). Contains CVR data (Erhvervsstyrelsen), CC BY 4.0. financials adds latest_financials (GB, FR (also associations that publish their accounts in the Journal officiel), DK, SE, NO, FI, US SEC filers and Regulation Crowdfunding issuers, EE, LT and RO headline figures, LV (also insurers, from Latvijas Banka), CO Superintendencia de Sociedades filers, BR listed companies, listed companies in ES, PL, HR, BE, SI, HU, LU and MT, JP EDINET filers, GR (GEMI's balance-sheet announcements, read gradually), UA banks, IE insurers, AU general insurers supervised by APRA, and the banks of the EBA Transparency Exercise 2025 in IT, NL, AT, PT and several of the countries above; Scale plan and above; see company_financials for the limits). charges (GB) asks Companies House live for the secured-debt summary when the nightly crawl has not reached it (the summary is registry_details.charges: outstanding, satisfied and part-satisfied counts, latest charge date, lenders of the outstanding charges; null = not fetched yet, unknown, never none). risk_flags is Spain and Colombia (procurement_fine: administrative fines on public contracts by NIT, not court judgments, with amount_original and currency) and each Spanish row states whether its identifier was read directly from the source or reconstructed with name corroboration. The stored flags of other countries (AU, FR, GB, IT, LV, PL, SK) come back with the same keys. metrics adds, for a company that has figures, {<metric>: {label, unit, periods: [{period_start, period_end, value}]}, source, source_url, as_of, credit} with the latest 8 periods of each metric, newest first, as the source published them (Great Britain: gender pay gap, bonus gap and payment practices of the employers that must report; Latvia: average employees and taxes paid per quarter for the companies the State Revenue Service lists); a company without a figure has none, which says nothing about it; 0 credits. securities adds {isin_count, isins, listings, as_of, source, credit} for a company with an LEI (null with a notice otherwise): the ISINs the GLEIF ISIN-to-LEI file links to the LEI (at most 100, sorted), as published, not necessarily every security the entity issued; listings is an empty list, no listing data is served yet; 0 credits. Every company object also carries parent_company and isin_count. One controlling company per company, from the first source that names one: the register (source register: a legal-entity shareholder holding 100 % (sole_shareholder) or more than 50 % (majority_shareholder) where the register names shareholders (ES, EE, LV, SK; GB: a legal entity whose significant-control shares band is 50-75 or 75-100 %, as majority_shareholder, never sole_shareholder), or the foreign head office of a Spanish branch (head_office)), then its own annual filing (annual_filing, controlling_entity or head_office: as declared, not checked; Colombia, NIIF filers of the Superintendencia de Sociedades), then the GLEIF direct accounting parent (gleif, accounting_parent: the entity that consolidates its accounts as the company reported it to GLEIF, not an ownership percentage). lei and company_id are set where the parent has an LEI or is a company we serve. Null where no source names one: not 'no parent'. On every company object (search items, details and lookups), at no extra credit; the full structure stays in include=structure.country_risk replaces the compact country_risk key every company carries (any_country_listed and lists for the registration and address country) with the full block: the same two keys over the registration country, the address country and the ultimate parent's country (GLEIF Level 2, from the same link as structure, or asked from GLEIF at the time of the request for an LEI-only layer; ultimate_parent_basis says why it is null: none_reported, not_linked for a company without an LEI, or unknown), each country's own lists, list_details (each list's legal basis, as_of and checked_on dates and source) and a note. Country-level only, never a finding about the company; EU lists only (high-risk third countries for money laundering; the tax list's Annex I and Annex II); the FATF lists are not included; the address country is the record's own only for the United Kingdom and Norway (every other register states none, so it is the register's own country).
